title: LabDef
description:
A lab definition file, e.g. `labs/<name>.json`, or a `lab.json` in your own project.

Two modes, decided by the machines: with one machine of `role: "dc"` the lab is an **AD domain** (`domain` and `netbios` required, users are domain users, the other machines join the domain); with no `dc` it is a **workgroup** (no domain; users are local accounts created on every machine). Any Windows Server may be the DC and any OS a member.

$schema.description: Optional path or URL of the JSON Schema, for editors (ignored by `lab`).

name.description: The lab's name: names its state folder `labs/state/<name>/` and its VMs. Default: the file name without `.json` (for a lab outside win-test-lab's `labs/`, plus a short hash of its path, so two projects' `lab.json` never share a state).

domain.description: AD mode: the forest's DNS name, e.g. `lab.local`. Must be absent in workgroup mode.

netbios.description: AD mode: the NetBIOS domain name, e.g. `LAB` (users log on as `LAB\student`). Must be absent in workgroup mode.

admin_password.description: Password of the Administrator: the domain Administrator (and DSRM) in AD mode, each machine's local Administrator in workgroup mode. Default `WinTest!2026` (what the base images are installed with).

network.description: The private network between the machines. Required unless the lab is one workgroup machine (which then only has the host's NAT network).

machines.description: The machines, keyed by computer name. At most one has `role: dc` (none = workgroup).

users.description: The users: domain users in AD mode (always in Domain Users), local users on every machine in workgroup mode (always in Users). Named groups are created if missing.

subnet.description: First three octets of the /24, e.g. `10.77.30` (DC gets .10, the others .20, .21, ...).

lan_port.description: Host loopback UDP port the multicast lab LAN uses (unique per running lab).

role.description: The compact role alias: `dc` (= `roles: ["ad-ds"]`) or `member` (= no roles). Mutually exclusive with `roles`.

roles.description: The server roles this machine runs (see [`LabRole`]): `ad-ds`, `ad-cs`, `dhcp`, `iis`. Mutually exclusive with `role`. Servers only.

features.description: Windows feature names to install during the build (`Install-WindowsFeature`), e.g. `Telnet-Client`. Servers only; an unknown name fails the build with the available list.

setup.description: Setup scripts run once during the build, in order, after the join/roles/features.

logon.description: A user (from `users`) this machine logs on as automatically; without one it logs on as Administrator. The DC cannot set one.

mem.description: RAM in MB (default 4096 for a member, 3072 for the DC).

ip.description: Static IPv4, either a full `a.b.c.d` or a bare last octet within the subnet. Default: DC `.10`, members `.20`, `.21`, ... in declaration order.

LabRole.description: A server role baked into the 0 state. A machine lists the roles it runs in `roles`; the old `role: "dc"` is an alias for `roles: ["ad-ds"]` and `role: "member"` for no roles.

oneOf.description: Active Directory Domain Services: makes this machine the domain controller (one per AD lab; promotes a new forest). A Windows Server.
AD Certificate Services: an Enterprise Root CA (needs the domain; installed as a domain admin after the join). A Windows Server.
DHCP server: a scope for the lab subnet, authorized in AD when there is a domain. A Windows Server.
IIS web server: `Web-Server` + the common features, the default site serving a test page. A Windows Server.

SetupDef.description: One setup script, run once during the 0-state build (after the join, roles and features).

run.description: the script to run, relative to the lab file: `.ps1 .bat .cmd .exe .msi`, e.g. `./setup/configure.ps1`. Staged onto the control disc and run during the build.

as.description: who to run it as: `system` (default) or a lab user (a domain user in AD mode)

AdCsDef.description: `ad_cs` options (an Enterprise Root CA). All optional; see the defaults in [`AdCsOpts`].

key_length.description: the CA key length in bits (default 2048)

validity_years.description: the root certificate's validity in years (default 5)

autoenroll.description: link a domain GPO that turns on computer + user certificate auto-enrollment, and publish the Workstation/User templates enrollable by Domain Computers/Users (default true)

range.description: the scope as last octets within the lab subnet, `.<start>-.<end>` (default `.100-.199`); router and DNS are the DC

site_path.description: the default site's physical path (default `C:\inetpub\wwwroot`); a test page is written there if one is not present

UserDef.description: One user (a domain user in AD mode, a local user on every machine in workgroup mode).

groups.description: Extra groups (domain groups in AD mode, e.g. "Domain Admins"; local groups in workgroup mode, e.g. "Administrators"). A group that does not exist is created.
